items.text: Mentoring juniors means helping them learn faster by sharing context, setting clear expectations, giving specific feedback and letting them make decisions safely, and it is a skill that supports promotion into lead and manager roles.
Agree goals and meeting rhythm with the junior, give examples instead of vague advice, and review progress together.
Follow your employer's policies on feedback, confidentiality and fair treatment.
